extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology record; automated placeholder claims were replaced with source-located, non-overclaiming evidence classes.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LyeTxI-b is the synthetic LyeTxI-derived peptide with N-terminal acetylation, deletion of one His residue, and C-terminal amidation; MS/MS confirmed the primary structure.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Identity evidence supports database sequence/modification adjudication; it is not itself an antimicrobial mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD and NMR evidence show a helical LyeTxI-b conformation in TFE, SDS micelles, and POPC:POPG vesicles, providing membrane-mimetic structural context.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote to direct bacterial membrane disruption; the local paper does not provide a bacterial permeabilization assay for LyeTxI-b.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: In vitro MIC/MBC and septic arthritis results support bacterial growth control as the source of reduced inflammatory readouts in vivo.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LyeTxI-b produced 46.83% lamb erythrocyte hemolysis at 46.8 μM, so eukaryotic-cell membrane toxicity remains a caution at high concentration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Normal lung/kidney cytotoxicity is mentioned as unpublished/not shown and is not curated as a recoverable local value.
